english.title: Driver of a large goods vehicle fail to produce his / her large goods vehicle driving licence to an authorised officer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person driving a large goods vehicle on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by

(A)_[an examiner appointed under section 68 of the Road Traffic Act 1988]_
(B)_[a certifying officer appointed under section 7(1) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981]_
(C)_[an examiner appointed under section 7(2) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981]_
(D)_[a person authorised for the purpose by a traffic commissioner appointed for the purposes of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981]_

failed to produce for examination your licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 164(6)of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) By section 166 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 all the powers of a constable exercisable under sections 164 and 165 are exercisable by the four categories above.
(ii) See offence wording H38 for the failure to produce licence to a constable.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H3319, H3320 and H3321.
